preconditions: 測地系 code and 孔口標高 are present
Original XML bytes and SHA-256 are retained

decisionLogic.geodeticCode0: Japanese Datum / old geodetic system; no automatic modern-CRS assignment
decisionLogic.geodeticCode1: JGD2000 / EPSG:4612 as declared by the exchange-format code table
decisionLogic.collarElevation: T.P. (Tokyo Bay mean sea level), metres, two decimal places as exchange-format semantics
decisionLogic.coordinateReadingPrecisionCode0: Integer arc-second resolution; retained decimal characters must not be promoted to verified precision

outputs: Separate individual coordinate and collar-elevation accuracy status
Source acquisition-method code and declared reading resolution
uncertainty: The format definition does not prove the individual survey method, epoch or accuracy.
exclusions: Does not perform JGD2000 to JGD2011 transformation
Does not verify individual collar elevation
Declared reading resolution is not survey accuracy
Does not authorize borehole correlation or subsurface geometry
validationMethod: Direct visual review of Appendix 5 Table 2-6 and printed page 付5-17; positive and fail-closed parser tests
reopenCondition: A different BED version, code outside 0/1, exceptional height datum, or record-specific survey metadata
